name: Epic wrap-up
description: Close out an epic: sync docs, commit, close the last task and roll up its story and epic, remove a scratch project's .mcp.json, close the last story, and remove the epic's merged worktrees, with the permission level raised to 5 only for the middle of the run.
examples: wrap up epic E65 with its last task E65_S05_T08 and story E65_S05
run the epic wrap-up workflow for E70

inputs.name: epic
inputs.description: Epic id whose merged worktrees are removed, e.g. E65

inputs.name: task
inputs.description: Id of the last open task, closed by j.close-task, e.g. E65_S05_T08

inputs.name: story
inputs.description: Id of the story closed by j.close-story, e.g. E65_S05

inputs.name: scratch_path
inputs.description: Directory of the scratch project whose .mcp.json is deleted

inputs.name: base
inputs.description: Branch the worktrees must be merged into

steps.prompt: Delete ${inputs.scratch_path}/.mcp.json? Permission level is 5 until the last step. If this run is abandoned, switch back with j.jenga-permission-level 2.

Worktrees matching ${inputs.epic} (only the 'removable' lines, merged into ${inputs.base} and clean, are removed; 'none' means nothing to do):
${steps.list_worktrees.outputs.candidates}
